title: Surreal Clock Tower Scene
description: A large green clock tower shaped like a sphere with a white clock face stands in the center of rolling green hills under a big teal circular sky. Butterflies, birds, colorful spheres, and a small house appear on the path and in the air around tall rocks and distant mountains.
prompt: A surreal scene shows a giant green spherical clock tower with a white clock face and arched doorway standing in the middle of green rolling hills. Butterflies, birds, and many colorful spheres float in the air around it under a large teal circular sky. A dirt path leads past a small house and tall rocks toward the tower with distant mountains in the background.
